title: Maffmatix and ILL Bill drops a brand new track "Grime Time"
htmlContent:
Maffmatix and ILL Bill shares a new single called "Grime Time," a super dope record that the world should hear. The music is packed with appeal, with a sound that is digestible for the masses, while still being a master class that showcases his talent to the fullest on this breakout record. The song has many great elements that work, but one of the more impressive elements is the writing. What can be a lost art for some, he excels majorly in with him mastering the art of tone in the vocals to make them felt even more.

 Maffmatix and ILL Bill's "Grime Time" is the right record at the right time to give people that more that they are looking for in music. It delivers a must hear sound that’s fresh in it’s approach, to bring a classic sound we all love, as well as an amazing display of music to let the artistry thrive in it’s pursuit to make a record for the world.
